prompts.name: england
prompts.prompt: Create ONE premium football identity design presentation board, exactly eight fictional club logos, 4 columns by 2 rows, landscape on plain warm ivory, evenly sized and ample spacing. Use attached approved board as STYLE AND DIVERSITY reference. Individual bespoke designs: different historical periods, silhouettes, typographic treatments, compositions. No repeated two-letter serif monograms, no waves, no filler initials, no generic template. Refined vector-like contours, flat colors, no gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no metallic texture, no invented dates or title stars. No real club logo copies. Below each logo print its EXACT full name in neutral small sans-serif, accents correct. Inside logos text only where explicitly specified; otherwise pure pictorial mark. Preserve approved reference designs when listed. Top row then bottom row left to right: 1 Regent Vale FC: red white black, preserve approved stag and oak heraldic shield, no internal letters. 2 Irwell FC: sky blue white navy, clean modern freestanding kingfisher silhouette, long pointed beak and folded angular wing, no enclosing badge, no letters. 3 Mersey Dock FC: purple cream gold, vintage wide oval badge, bold cargo ship front view between two dock bollards, simple solid waterline NOT waves, small MERSEY DOCK in sturdy slab capitals integrated on bottom strip. 4 Birmingham Works FC: gold black white, preserve approved freestanding anvil with spark and bold WORKS base. 5 Bristol Quay FC: turquoise burgundy cream, midcentury vertical port-authority pennant, stylized harbor crane integrated with vertical rope and cargo hook, no text. 6 Wandle Town: forest green white gold, preserve approved Wandle handlettered script wordmark with leaf terminal and TOWN below. 7 Sheffield Forge FC: rust red ivory midnight blue, heraldic crossed forging tongs behind a broad triangular furnace opening and central flame, compact unframed symbol, no lettering. 8 Plymouth Bay AFC: navy orange cream, vintage coastal rectangular badge with rounded top, bold lighthouse against large orange sun, PLYMOUTH in narrow sans along base, no waves.
